issue_request: FHIR-38931 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. OO requested adding Task.performer 0..* with function and actor children, making the actual performer searchable, updating Task.owner to mean the party responsible for managing task execution, and removing Device and HealthcareService from Task.owner references.

The main add commit used the typo FHIR-389931, but it added Task.performer and the owner definition/reference changes; follow-up commits refined Task.performer wording and requestedPerformer search handling.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied core issue FHIR-41394 intentionally added Group to Task requester, requestedPerformer, owner, and performer.actor with a family/household-use comment, explaining why the current reference lists differ from the original FHIR-38931 resolution. Later FHIR-cow issues FHIR-50747, FHIR-50813, FHIR-50816, and FHIR-50839 clarify owner/performer guidance outside this core checkout.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition contains Task.performer/function/actor and the requested owner definition, Device and HealthcareService are absent from Task.owner, and the search parameter source includes Task.performer.actor.
